author: Inside Edition
description: A soldier was reunited with a dog he bonded with while serving in the Middle East. Army Specialist Jeremy Ferris says when he was sent back home after his deployment, he was afraid he would never see Sadie again. He contacted Paws of War, an organization that helps veterans and dogs recover from the trauma of being in a warzone. They were able to get Sadie from Jordan to Connecticut, where Ferris lives. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: US Soldier Adopts Dog He Bonded With While Deployed In Middle East
